shellCommands.command: for f in app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx app/globals.css app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx "app/product/[slug]/page.tsx" lib/products.ts next.config.ts tsconfig.json; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done
ls __agent_eval__ && cat node_modules/react/package.json | head -20 && cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep -E '"version"|"react"' | head

grep -o "unstable_ViewTransition\|ViewTransition\|unstable_addTransitionType" node_modules/react/cjs/react.development.js | sort -u; echo "--- index"; cat node_modules/react/index.js; echo "--- next react ver"; ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react* -d 2>/dev/null; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs

echo "--- compiled/react exports"; grep -o "exports.ViewTransition\|ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.development.js | sort | uniq -c; echo "--- @types/react"; grep -n "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts | head -20; echo "--- link types"; grep -rn "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/link.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/shared/lib/router/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

sed -n 1,40p node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts; echo "=== grep const ViewTransition"; grep -n "ViewTransition:" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts; echo "=== next-env"; cat next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null; ls .next 2>/dev/null | head

(npm start > /tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; curl -s localhost:3000 -o /tmp/home.html -w "home:%{http_code}\n"; curl -s localhost:3000/product/classic-sneakers -o /tmp/detail.html -w "detail:%{http_code}\n"; grep -o "view-transition[^\";]*" /tmp/home.html /tmp/detail.html | head; grep -ci "error" /tmp/start.log; tail -5 /tmp/start.log

css=$(grep -o '/_next/static/css/[^"]*\.css' /tmp/home.html | head -1); echo "$css"; curl -s "localhost:3000$css" | grep -o "::view-transition[a-z-]*(\.[a-z-]*)\|prefers-reduced-motion[^{]*" | sort -u; ls node_modules | grep -iE "playwright|puppeteer" ; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null
pkill -f "next start" ; pkill -f "next-server" ; sleep 1; git status --short; git diff --stat
git diff tsconfig.json; echo "=== gitignore"; cat .gitignore
git checkout tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo next-env.d.ts && npx tsc --noEmit && echo "TYPECHECK OK" && git status --short
